extracted.name: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches
extracted.description: Easy BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches served with pineapple slaw will be the dinner everyone raves about!
ingredient_lines: 2 lb cooked pulled pork ((our recipe is easy and delicious))
2 cups BBQ sauce ((576g), homemade or store-bought)
1 1/2 Tablespoons fresh pineapple juice ((just use any reserved from cutting the fresh pineapple))
instruction_lines: Cook pork: Season and cook pork in oven, slow cooker or instant pot. Shred meat and add BBQ sauce, stirring to coat.
Make Slaw: Mix the slaw and dressing ingredients in two separate bowls. Pour dressing over slaw and stir well to combine. Refrigerate for at least an hour, or until ready to serve.
Assemble: Serve pulled pork on buns, topped with slaw, if desired.
categories: Bbq pulled pork sandwich with coleslaw
